act: AIFC Conduct of Business Rules (COB), V17

en.title: COB 8.5 was extended to Insurance Managers but the distribution waterfall and agency rule still name only the Insurance Intermediary
en.summary: Amendments No. 2 rewrote the old COB 11.8 as COB 8.5 for "an Insurance Intermediary or Insurance Manager", and that phrase runs through COB 8.5. Three places still name only the Insurance Intermediary: 8.5.15(2)(c) "where insufficient funds are held by the Insurance Intermediary"; 8.5.15(2)(d)(i) "trustee in bankruptcy over the Insurance Intermediary, payment must be made accordance with the AIFC Insolvency Regulations"; and 8.5.5(b) "once the money is received by the Insurance Intermediary". The Investment Business rule 8.2.16(2)(d)(i) covers "the Authorised Firm or the Nominee Company".
en.correction: Please add "or Insurance Manager" after "Insurance Intermediary" in COB 8.5.15(2)(c), 8.5.15(2)(d)(i) and 8.5.5(b), and read "made in accordance with" in 8.5.15(2)(d)(i).
